description: A shell command streams partial output via bash_execution_update while running, then settles as a bashExecution message.
notes: bash_execution_update is named explicitly in plan.md's 21-type list (line ~712) but is not yet declared as a literal in packages/server/.../pi/rpc-types.ts, which currently only models the settled result as a `role: "bashExecution"` message emitted via message_start/message_end. This fixture captures the streaming update shape (mirrored from the settled message fields: command, output, exitCode, cancelled, timestamp) so the union can be extended without losing data. Flag for whoever wires bash_execution_update into rpc-types.ts (outside this task's scope).
